items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The manager of the room at that time was called Bushy. And I saw Bushy and Jenny getting their heads together

ctx.x:
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Well, in those days you worked, as I said before you sang at the tables and you stayed there until somebody gave you a tip. Well, in the beginning, Lulu was the other girl's name, she would do her rounds and come back and she would come back with money, a lot of money and put it in the kitty. And of course my being new and probably a little unsophisticated, I would come back with nickels, dimes and quarters. And of course, one of the handicaps was if you didn't come back with a lot of money to put in the kitty…
